fullPassage: Astronauts feel weightless when they travel outside our planet's atmosphere because the speed of a spacecraft in orbit balances the force of Earth's gravitational pull. In fact, you may have experienced a similar feeling when riding a roller coaster. As the roller coaster car climbs up the track, gravity pulls your body downward, and you feel yourself pushed down on your seat. However, when the car rushes down, your body hangs in the air until it is pulled down by your safety belt. Using this phenomenon, NASA prepares its astronauts for space travel. The astronauts fly in an aircraft that ascends to an altitude of 24,000 feet, and once the aircraft dives down, the passengers experience about 20 to 25 seconds of weightlessness. These flights help astronauts get used to the environment of space, and they allow NASA to conduct experiments and test equipment in a similar environment as well.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 빈칸을 완성하시오. (영어로)
'여러분은 비슷한 느낌을 경험한 적이 있을지도 모른다'
[조건] (1) a, experienced, feeling, have, may, similar, you 를 모두 사용
(2) 7단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: may have p.p. = ~한 적이 있을지도 모른다(과거에 대한 추측). you may have experienced(경험한 적이 있을지도 모른다).
det.analysis:
본문 문장: 'In fact, ______ when riding a roller coaster.(사실, 롤러코스터를 탈 때 ~)'

① 주어 you(여러분)로 시작해요.

② '~한 적이 있을지도 모른다'는 과거에 대한 추측이라 조동사 may + have + 과거분사(experienced)를 써요 → may have experienced.

③ 경험한 대상은 a similar feeling(비슷한 느낌)이에요.

④ 순서대로 이으면 you may have experienced a similar feeling (7단어)예요.
det.tip: may have p.p. = (과거에) ~했을지도 모른다 → you may have experienced.

questions.wa: you may have experienced a similar feeling
accept: you may have experienced a similar feeling
